answer: My answer to sybils is Registered newspaper editor record with press standards attestation — editions standards recorded across years of papers — which makes the opal of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: editions standards recorded across years of papers is fresh per account, and the orchard is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the pigment of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
